title: SiDiary-Export did not contain other Therapeutic Data (KH,IE, ect)
symptom: The SiDiary export only includes CGMS data, not other therapeutic data like carbohydrates and insulin, which is needed for a complete overview and discussion with the doctor.
evidence_quote: It seems that only the CGMS Data are included in the Export for SiDiary. For a overall-View and discussion with the doctor a complete export should be possible.
